title: n8n reads every invoice PDF into Airtable #shorts
description:
One n8n workflow reads every invoice that lands in Gmail. A Gmail trigger checks the inbox every minute, mail with an attachment goes through, the PDF is filed in Google Drive and its text is pulled out. Gemini reads the text and returns the invoice name, the company, the total and every line item. Airtable gets one row per invoice (subject, sender, Drive link, total) and one row per line item in a second table, linked back. Nothing is typed.

The importable workflow and the node-by-node wiring notes are in the community: https://www.skool.com/nijoson-bosco-3533

You need n8n, a Google account (Gmail and Drive), a Gemini key from Google AI Studio and an Airtable account.

#n8n #automation #invoice #airtable #gmail #gemini
